title: EU Food Information & Labelling — Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011
summary: For prepacked foods intended for the final consumer, check mandatory food information such as name, ingredients, allergens, net quantity, date marking, storage/use instructions, responsible food business operator details and nutrition information, with additional rules for specific foods.
evidence: Responsible EU food business operator details

title: EU Pesticide Residue — Maximum Residue Levels (MRLs)
summary: Check the current EU MRL database for the relevant active substance and commodity. Imported food must meet applicable EU residue limits; the actual value should be looked up rather than assumed.
evidence: Pesticide residue test report where risk-based verification is needed

title: EU Food Contaminants — Regulation (EU) 2023/915
summary: Check maximum levels for contaminants that are relevant to the product category. The exact contaminant/product combination must be verified in the current consolidated legal text.

title: EU Food Contact Materials — Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004
summary: Food-contact materials need to meet the applicable EU general safety framework. Appearance alone cannot establish conformity.
evidence: Supplier Declaration of Compliance where applicable

title: EU Plastic Food-Contact Materials — Regulation (EU) No 10/2011
summary: Plastic food-contact materials are subject to specific EU requirements including authorised substances and migration-related rules. Exact material/layer structure must be established from technical documentation.

title: EU Food-Contact GMP — Regulation (EC) No 2023/2006
summary: Good manufacturing practice requirements apply to food-contact materials and articles. The relevant supplier/manufacturer controls should be checked.

title: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste — Regulation (EU) 2025/40
summary: The PPWR creates EU packaging and packaging-waste requirements. Applicability, timing and actor responsibilities depend on the packaging and supply-chain role.

title: Germany Packaging EPR — LUCID / producer-obligation screening
summary: Check whether the actual producer/importer role and packaging classification trigger German packaging registration, system participation and reporting obligations.

title: UK Food Import & Labelling — preliminary screening
summary: UK food imports need to meet applicable UK food law and labelling requirements. The exact controls depend on commodity, origin, product presentation and import route.

source.name: GOV.UK — Food safety and hygiene for your business

title: UK Packaging EPR — producer obligation screening
summary: Packaging EPR obligations can apply depending on the producer activity, UK establishment, packaging quantities and turnover thresholds. The exact obligation must be assessed for the business role.

source.name: GOV.UK — Check if you must comply with EPR for packaging

title: US Food Import — FDA screening
summary: Imported food must meet applicable US requirements. Depending on the product and supply chain, requirements can include food facility registration, prior notice, labelling, FSMA/FSVP and commodity-specific controls.

source.name: FDA — Importing Food Products into the United States

title: Canada Food Import — SFCR screening
summary: Canadian food imports generally require checks under the Safe Food for Canadians Regulations, including importer licensing, preventive controls and traceability, with additional commodity-specific requirements in some cases.

source.name: CFIA — Importing food to Canada: general requirements

title: Australia Food Import — Food Standards Code & border screening
summary: Food imported for sale in Australia must comply with the Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code and applicable biosecurity and imported-food controls.

title: Japan Food Import — Food Sanitation Act notification screening
summary: Importers of food, food additives, apparatus, containers and packaging for sale or business use must submit an import notification as required under Japan's Food Sanitation Act. Additional product-specific controls may apply.

source.name: MHLW — Imported Food Safety / Import Procedure

title: China Imported Prepacked Food — Chinese labelling screening
summary: Imported prepackaged foods are subject to Chinese food-safety and labelling requirements. Chinese-language labelling and required origin/domestic agent information should be checked against the applicable standards and import model.

source.name: SAMR — Food Safety Law of the PRC

title: Saudi Arabia Food Import — SFDA conditions & requirements screening
summary: Saudi food imports are subject to SFDA conditions and requirements. Exact documentation and product controls depend on the food category and shipment circumstances.
evidence: Certificates or test reports where applicable

source.name: SFDA — Conditions & Requirements for Importing Food to Saudi Arabia
